title: E-ink engine
description: EinkProvider, table-driven refresh engine, useEinkRefresh and useSteppedDrag.

files.content:
"use client"

import { createContext } from "react"

import type { EinkEngine } from "./engine"
import type { EinkIntensity } from "./types"

export type EinkContextValue = {
  engine: EinkEngine | null
  intensity: EinkIntensity
  isReducedMotion: boolean
  setIntensity: (intensity: EinkIntensity) => void
}

export const EinkContext = createContext<EinkContextValue>({
  engine: null,
  intensity: "off",
  isReducedMotion: false,
  setIntensity: () => {},
})

export { ditherOnCpu } from "./ditherOnCpu"
export type { DitherRequest, DitherSource } from "./ditherRenderer"
export type { EinkContextValue } from "./einkContext"
export { EinkProvider, type EinkProviderProps } from "./EinkProvider"
export { createEinkEngine, type EinkEngine } from "./engine"
export { EINK_INTENSITIES, INTENSITY_SETTINGS } from "./intensitySettings"
export { observeTheme } from "./observeTheme"
export { readFps, readInks, readPixel } from "./readTokens"
export { readElementRect, readViewportRect } from "./rects"
export {
  FULL_REFRESH_INTERVAL,
  REFRESH_EFFECTS,
  REFRESH_SEQUENCES,
} from "./refreshSequences"
export type {
  BayerMatrixSize,
  EinkIntensity,
  InkPalette,
  Rect,
  RefreshKind,
  RefreshPhase,
} from "./types"
export { useEink } from "./useEink"
export { useEinkRefresh } from "./useEinkRefresh"
export { useInkVersion } from "./useInkVersion"
export { type Point, type SteppedDrag, useSteppedDrag } from "./useSteppedDrag"

import type { RefreshPhase } from "./types"

export const PHASE_SHADER_MODES: Record<RefreshPhase, number | null> = {
  flash: 0,
  invert: 1,
  noise: 2,
  clear: null,
}

import type { RefreshKind, RefreshPhase } from "./types"

export const REFRESH_SEQUENCES: Record<RefreshKind, readonly RefreshPhase[]> = {
  partial: ["noise", "clear"],
  region: ["flash", "invert", "noise", "clear"],
  full: ["flash", "invert", "flash", "invert", "noise", "clear"],
}

export type RefreshScope = "rect" | "viewport"

export type RefreshEffect = {
  scope: RefreshScope
  rank: number
  coverage: number
  leavesGhost: boolean
  clearsGhosts: boolean
  countsTowardFull: boolean
}

export const REFRESH_EFFECTS: Record<RefreshKind, RefreshEffect> = {
  partial: {
    scope: "rect",
    rank: 0,
    coverage: 0.5,
    leavesGhost: true,
    clearsGhosts: false,
    countsTowardFull: false,
  },
  region: {
    scope: "rect",
    rank: 1,
    coverage: 1,
    leavesGhost: false,
    clearsGhosts: true,
    countsTowardFull: true,
  },
  full: {
    scope: "viewport",
    rank: 2,
    coverage: 1,
    leavesGhost: false,
    clearsGhosts: true,
    countsTowardFull: false,
  },
}

export const FULL_REFRESH_INTERVAL = 8
